hero.headline: Specialist industrial engineering support for UAE projects
hero.sub: Alanpire provides project management, technical consultancy, and architectural drawings. Our engineers deliver planning, modelling, and technical coordination under the supervision of your licensed UAE consultant.

pillars.heading: Four Licensed Service Areas
pillars.intro: We provide technical engineering support under three directly licensed categories in Dubai, coordinating deliverables with client-appointed consultants.

items.title: Project Management
items.tagline: Baseline scheduling and contractor interface coordination.
items.desc: We build critical-path schedules in Primavera P6 and administer live risk registers. Our team verifies site progress weekly and coordinates interfaces across trade contractors.
deliverables: Critical-path baseline schedules in Primavera P6 format
Weekly risk register updates and mitigation tracking
Multi-contractor interface matrices and coordination meetings
Independent weekly site progress verification reports
Document control, submittal tracking, and technical logs
Testing and commissioning close-out packages

items.title: Technical Consultancy
items.tagline: Process modelling, hydraulic calculations, and bid evaluations.
items.desc: We evaluate equipment specifications, verify hydraulic calculations, and draft tender packages. Our engineers analyse system constraints across district heating networks, pumping stations, and industrial facilities.
deliverables: Thermal and hydraulic network modelling
Process equipment specifications and datasheet reviews
Tender technical evaluations and contractor bid scoring
Existing utility condition assessments and defect logs
Materials compatibility assessments for high-pressure systems
System integration reviews for multi-unit industrial plants

items.title: Architectural Drawings
items.tagline: Prospective architectural layouts and industrial arrangement plans.
items.desc: Our DIEZ-licensed service drafts prospective architectural drawings and industrial layouts. We produce equipment arrangements, utility routing corridors, and spatial zoning schemes.
deliverables: Prospective architectural layouts for industrial buildings
Industrial equipment arrangement and zoning drawings
Utility corridor alignment and pipe-rack routing plans
Preliminary space-planning layouts for plant operators
Drawing package coordination and revision control
Concept layouts for client and stakeholder reviews

items.title: Management Consultancy
items.tagline: Capital planning, stage-gate reviews, and procurement advisory.
items.desc: We analyse industrial operating workflows and prepare project governance frameworks. Our consultants evaluate capital expenditure budgets and support dispute resolution with technical documentation.
deliverables: Capital expenditure planning and stage-gate reviews
Project governance frameworks and delegation matrices
Contractor dispute analysis and technical claim documentation
Operational readiness reviews before facility handover
Technical due diligence for industrial asset transactions
Procurement packaging strategies for major equipment

sectors.heading: Five Industrial Sectors
sectors.intro: Our technical experience spans heavy utility, industrial generation, and fluid transport systems.

items.title: Power and Energy Generation
items.desc: Technical coordination for generation halls, cooling loops, auxiliary piping, and plant expansion programs.

items.title: District Heating and Thermal Utilities
items.desc: Hydraulic network modelling, thermal expansion compensation, pressure regulation stations, and custody metering nodes.

items.title: Water Infrastructure
items.desc: Transmission main rehabilitation, pipe material evaluation, pump station hydraulic design, and interface coordination.

items.title: Oil Refining and Petrochemicals
items.desc: Process unit coordination, piping isometric review, equipment layout schemes, and contractor package governance.

items.title: Industrial Facilities and Manufacturing
items.desc: Spatial planning, equipment foundation coordinates, utility corridors, and building layout drawings.

process.heading: Five-Stage Delivery Method
process.intro: Each technical engagement follows a five-stage delivery method with written deliverables at each milestone.

items.title: Understand
items.desc: We review existing technical documentation, boundary limits, and statutory constraints to define assignment scope.

items.title: Define
items.desc: We establish the baseline schedule, calculation criteria, document submission register, and interface matrix.

items.title: Coordinate
items.desc: We resolve contractor technical queries, check drawing revisions, and conduct weekly technical review sessions.

items.title: Deliver
items.desc: We produce progress tracking dashboards, evaluate earned-value milestones, and submit verified calculation packages.

items.title: Close
items.desc: We assemble as-built drawing sets, review punch-list close-outs, and compile operations handover dossiers.
